Hello,

The Information School at the University of Wisconsin—Madison is looking to hire this year.  As part of the newly formed College of Computing and Artificial Intelligence, we are looking to hire multiple faculty across all areas of the department, which includes all areas of HCI, all areas of information science and all areas of library science.

The Information School seeks highly qualified candidates for multiple tenure-track or tenured faculty positions in all areas of library and information science.  All faculty positions will be academic nine-month, tenure-track or tenured appointments at the Assistant, Associate, or Full Professor level, starting August 2027.
